title: Acidogenic fermentation of dairy by-products for the utilization of volatile fatty acids IN PHBV production by Haloferax mediterranei
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00279B, Paper
Open Access

Leire Urbina, Eric Rovira-Cal, Ibai Nafarrate, Ana Urkiaga, Josu Berganza, Enrique Aymerich, Maria José Suárez
Acidogenic fermentation of cheese whey was performed to obtain streams rich in volatile fatty acids, which were successfully used as carbon substrates to biosynthesize polyhydroxyalcanoates by the bacterial strain Haloferax mediterranei.
